infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ROAM records your journey route, cities and places while a journey is active. Tracking is always visible and can be paused.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ROAM uses the camera to capture travel photos and videos for your journey.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ROAM lets you add existing photos and videos to your journeys.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ROAM records audio with your travel videos.
